quests.dispatcherQuestion: A fire has broken out on the third floor of a busy apartment building at night. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed given the size of the building.
quests.explanation: An apartment fire at night needs several engines to fight the fire and check every floor for residents.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Residents on the upper floors cannot get past the smoke-filled stairwell. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Say what equipment can reach them from outside.
quests.explanation: A ladder truck can reach trapped residents through a window when the stairwell itself is unsafe.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: All residents are now accounted for and the fire is fully under control. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what happens to the crews once the danger has passed.
quests.explanation: Standing crews down once everyone is safe frees them to respond to the next call.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A five-car pileup has happened on a foggy motorway with several people trapped. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed given more than one person is hurt.
quests.explanation: Several vehicles involved usually means several injured people, so more than one ambulance should be sent.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Traffic is still moving toward the crash site in the thick fog. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what must happen to stop more vehicles arriving.
quests.explanation: Closing the road prevents a second crash from other drivers who can't see the first one in time.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: One driver is trapped in a crushed car and cannot be freed by hand. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Say what tool is needed to free him.
quests.explanation: Specialist cutting equipment can open a crushed car safely without hurting the driver further.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Heavy rainfall for two days has caused a river to burst its banks near a housing estate. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the residents there.
quests.explanation: Getting residents out ahead of rising water is far safer than waiting until the flood arrives.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Several elderly residents refuse to leave their flooding ground-floor homes. Input rescue code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed to reach homes surrounded by water.
quests.explanation: A boat team can reach and safely persuade or carry out residents once water blocks the roads.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The floodwater has now fully receded and engineers confirm the homes are structurally safe. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen now the area is safe.
quests.explanation: Residents can return home safely only once engineers confirm there's no lasting structural damage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A gas leak has been confirmed under a street, affecting six connected homes. Input code!
quests.hint: Say exactly how many homes must be cleared.
quests.explanation: Naming the exact number of homes ensures every affected household is checked and evacuated, not just some.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Engineers have located the source of the leak beneath the road surface. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what must be closed at the source.
quests.explanation: Shutting off the gas main stops more gas from reaching the leak while it is repaired.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Gas levels inside the homes have returned to a safe reading after venting. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen now the area is safe.
quests.explanation: Residents can only return once readings confirm the gas has fully cleared from every home.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A school reports a stranger repeatedly trying to enter through a side gate during lessons. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the standard school safety procedure to start.
quests.explanation: A lockdown keeps children safely inside classrooms while staff and police check who the stranger is.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Teachers confirm all classroom doors are locked and children are away from windows. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should be confirmed back to the school.
quests.explanation: Confirming the lockdown is complete lets the school office know every classroom is properly secured.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Police identify the stranger as a parent who forgot their visitor pass. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can now be lifted, given the good news.
quests.explanation: Ending the lockdown once the situation is fully explained lets lessons return to normal quickly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A small ferry's engine has caught fire mid-crossing with forty passengers aboard. Input fire code!
quests.hint: Ask for the service that responds to emergencies at sea.
quests.explanation: The coast guard has vessels and training suited to reaching a burning boat and its passengers safely.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Passengers are being moved to the open deck away from the smoke below. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what safety equipment should be given out.
quests.explanation: Life jackets are the first safety step for any passenger vessel emergency, even before evacuation begins.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The fire is out and the ferry can now be towed safely to shore. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should happen to the disabled ferry.
quests.explanation: Towing the ferry to shore gets everyone safely back on land once the immediate fire risk is over.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A conveyor belt has jammed with a worker's sleeve caught inside a food factory. Input code!
quests.hint: Say the fastest way to stop the machine.
quests.explanation: The emergency stop halts the belt instantly, which is far faster than switching it off normally.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The worker's arm is free but he has a deep cut from the machine. Input medical code!
quests.hint: Ask plainly for trained help to be sent.
quests.explanation: A machinery injury like this needs paramedics to assess and treat the wound properly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Managers need to know if the same machine has caused injuries before. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what record should be reviewed.
quests.explanation: Checking past incident records helps managers decide if the machine needs repair before it's used again.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A severe thunderstorm warning has been issued for an outdoor music festival with ten thousand fans. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what should stop before the storm arrives.
quests.explanation: Pausing the show gives staff time to move the crowd to shelter before lightning becomes a real risk.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Festival staff are directing fans toward the covered car park for shelter. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what needs to be made available to the crowd.
quests.explanation: Opening the covered car park gives thousands of fans a safe, dry place to wait out the storm.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The storm has passed and organizers confirm the festival grounds are safe again. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can start again once it's safe.
quests.explanation: Resuming only after a safety check keeps fans from returning to a stage area that isn't fully checked.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A hillside search is underway for a hiker who missed his check-in time by six hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Ask for the team trained to look for him.
quests.explanation: A trained search team can cover ground systematically and knows how to read trail signs he may have left.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The search team has found his backpack near a stream but no sign of him. Input code!
quests.hint: Say where the search should now focus.
quests.explanation: Following the stream from where the backpack was found is the most likely direction he may have gone.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The hiker is found safe nearby with a sprained ankle that slowed him down. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what's needed to bring him down safely.
quests.explanation: A stretcher team can carry him off the hillside without him having to walk on the injured ankle.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: A driver has crashed into a utility pole, knocking out power to a whole neighborhood. Input code!
quests.hint: Formally ask for the ambulance to be sent.
quests.explanation: Checking on the driver's injuries comes first, since the crash itself may have hurt him badly.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Live wires from the fallen pole are hanging low across the road. Input safety code!
quests.hint: Say what should be done to protect drivers and walkers.
quests.explanation: Closing the road keeps anyone from touching or driving near a wire that may still be live.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: The power company confirms the wire has been made safe and disconnected. Input code!
quests.hint: Say what can happen once the wire is confirmed safe.
quests.explanation: Reopening the road only after official confirmation avoids any risk from a wire that only looks safe.
